title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
九天童戏院
生旦净丑戏人生
唱念做打讲故事
亲爱的 小朋友，你们好！我是戏曲小精灵九天星。你们看，我的这身打扮很酷吧？它源自中华传统的戏曲艺术——我头上戴的帽子叫盔头，帽子上插着的叫翎子，脖子上挂的是金锁，身上披的是斗篷，脚上穿的是云靴；而我头上的九颗星星，代表戏曲演员的四功“唱、念、做、打”和五法“手、眼、身、法、步”。
很高兴成为你的朋友，请跟着我到充满魅力的戏曲世界里来看一看吧！这里可以看大戏、听小曲儿、耍棍棒、翻跟头、骑大马、抓坏人……还可以听各种各样有趣又精彩的故事哦！
今天我们要去看的是粤剧《劈山救母》。粤剧又叫广东大戏，流传于广东、广西、港澳和东南亚华侨聚居区，是由外来的梆黄声腔吸收当地民间音乐发展而成的。《劈山救母》讲的是三圣母的儿子沉香苦练武功，勇斗天兵天将，劈开华山，救出母亲的故事。快跟我一起去看看这出感人的大戏吧！

page_text_en:
Nine Sky Children's Theatre
Life in Roles: Sheng, Dan, Jing, Chou
Singing, Speaking, Acting, Fighting — Telling Stories
Dear children, hello! I am the opera little spirit, Jiutianxing. Look at my cool costume? It comes from traditional Chinese opera art — the hat I wear is called a helmet, the feathers on it are called lingzi, the golden lock around my neck, the cloak I wear, and the cloud boots on my feet. The nine stars on my head represent the four skills of opera performers — 'Singing, Speaking, Acting, Fighting' — and the five methods — 'Hand, Eye, Body, Method, Step'.
I'm very happy to become your friend. Please follow me to explore the fascinating world of opera! Here you can watch grand operas, listen to little tunes, play with sticks, flip over, ride horses, catch bad guys... and also hear all kinds of interesting and wonderful stories!
Today, we are going to watch the Cantonese opera 'Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother'. Cantonese opera, also known as Guangdong Opera, is popular in Guangdong, Guangxi, Hong Kong, Macao, and overseas Chinese communities in Southeast Asia. It developed by absorbing local folk music into the imported Bang Huang vocal style. 'Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother' tells the story of Shenxiang, the son of the Three Holy Mothers, who trains hard in martial arts, bravely fights against heavenly soldiers and generals, splits Mount Hua, and rescues his mother. Come with me to watch this touching grand opera!

summary_zh: 本页通过戏曲小精灵九天星的介绍，向小读者们讲解了传统戏曲的服饰、四功五法，并引出即将观看的粤剧《劈山救母》，同时介绍了粤剧的起源和特点。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
高高的山峰巍峨挺拔，一朵朵白云从山腰飘过。
这里是华山，沉香的母亲就被压
在这座山下。
page_text_en:
Towering peaks rise majestically, with white clouds drifting past the mountain waist.
This is Mount Hua, where Chenxiang's mother is trapped beneath the mountain.
summary_zh: 画面描绘了巍峨的华山，云雾缭绕，文字说明沉香的母亲被压在这座山下。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
十多年前，沉香的母亲还是天上的仙女——三圣母。
但她一心向往凡间的生活，便带着神物宝莲灯，嫁给了
凡间的小伙子刘彦昌。
神仙私自下凡触犯了天条，三圣母很快就受到了惩罚——她被压在了华山之下，不见天日。
后来，三圣母生下了儿子沉香。一个好心的夜叉偷偷把沉香送回了他父亲身边。
page_text_en:
Many years ago, Shenxiang's mother was still a fairy in heaven—San Sheng Mu.
But she longed for life in the mortal world, so she brought the magical treasure, the Lotus Lamp, and married
the mortal young man Liu Yanchang.
Fairy secretly descending to the mortal world violated heavenly law, and San Sheng Mu soon received punishment—she was pressed beneath Mount Hua, never seeing the light of day.
Later, San Sheng Mu gave birth to her son Shenxiang. A kind-hearted night demon secretly returned Shenxiang to his father's side.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了沉香母亲三圣母的身世：她本是天上的仙女，因私自下凡与凡人刘彦昌成婚而被天庭惩罚，压在华山之下。她生下儿子沉香后，由一个好心的夜叉将沉香送回父亲身边。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
日子一天天过去，小沉香慢慢长大了。
当他听说母亲的遭遇后，心里十分悲愤。这一天，他看着母亲留下的宝莲灯，握紧拳头在心里发誓：我一定要把母亲救出来！
page_text_en:
Days passed, and little Chenxiang grew up.
When he heard about his mother's fate, he felt deeply angry and sorrowful. On this day, looking at the precious Lotus Lamp left by his mother, he clenched his fists and vowed silently in his heart: I must rescue my mother!
summary_zh: 小沉香在得知母亲被压在华山下的遭遇后，内心悲愤，看着母亲留下的宝莲灯，立下誓言要救出母亲。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
沉香开始不分昼夜地练习武功。
白天，他在烈日下勤学苦练。
沉香的站姿很英武吧？你也学着他的样子站一站吧！
page_text_en:
Chenxiang began to practice martial arts day and night.
During the day, he diligently trained under the scorching sun.
Chenxiang's stance is very heroic, isn't it? Try standing like him!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了沉香不分昼夜刻苦练功的场景，左侧展示他练习各种武术动作，右侧则呈现他在山巅英武站立的姿态，旁边的小精灵鼓励读者模仿他的站姿。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
晚上，他沐浴着清凉的月光，
不知疲倦地继续操练。
page_text_en:
At night, he bathed in the cool moonlight,
and continued practicing tirelessly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了沉香在月光下于山间刻苦练功的场景，上方展示了他练习武术动作的连环图，下方是他在岩石上练习的全景画面，文字说明他不知疲倦地继续操练。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 一天，沉香得到了一枚宝贵的晶石，他用晶石炼成了一把神斧。
page_text_en: One day, Shenxiang obtained a precious crystal stone. He used the crystal to forge a divine axe.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了沉香获得一枚宝贵的晶石，并将其炼制成一把神斧，为后续劈山救母做准备。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 有了这把神斧，沉香练起功来更带劲儿了。
page_text_en: With this magical axe, Shen Xiang's training became even more energetic.
summary_zh: 沉香获得神斧后，练功更加带劲，画面展示了他在不同场景下挥舞神斧的英姿。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
又过了好些日子，沉香觉得自己已经做好去救母亲的准备了。
看——他手舞神斧，身披金甲，双目圆瞪，
一身正气！
在戏曲里，像沉香这样的男生被称为“生”。
page_text_en:
After a while, Shen Xiang felt he was ready to rescue his mother.
Look— he wields the divine axe, clad in golden armor, eyes wide and fierce,
full of righteous energy!
In opera, boys like Shen Xiang are called 'Sheng'.
summary_zh: 沉香觉得自己已准备好救母，他身披金甲、手舞神斧，英姿飒爽。画面下方的小精灵解释，在戏曲中像沉香这样的男生被称为“生”。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 沉香来到华山，他要用神斧将山峰劈开，救出母亲。
page_text_en: Chenxiang arrives at Mount Hua. He is going to use his divine axe to split the mountain peak and rescue his mother.
summary_zh: 沉香来到华山，准备用神斧劈开山峰救出被压在山下的母亲。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
天兵天将得知沉香要劈山救母，纷纷赶来阻拦。
大敌当前，沉香毫不畏惧，挥起神斧勇敢应战。
page_text_en:
The heavenly soldiers and generals, upon learning that Shenxiang intends to split the mountain to rescue his mother, rush to block him.
Facing the overwhelming enemy, Shenxiang remains fearless and bravely fights back with his divine axe.
summary_zh: 沉香来到华山准备劈山救母，天兵天将闻讯赶来阻拦，他毫不畏惧，挥动神斧勇敢迎战。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 天兵天将起初认为沉香只是个孩子，根本不堪一击，没想到沉香武艺高强，而且还越战越勇。不久，天兵天将们渐渐败下阵来。
page_text_en: At first, the heavenly soldiers and generals thought Shenxiang was just a child, utterly incapable of resisting. But they didn't expect that Shenxiang was highly skilled in martial arts and became braver as the battle went on. Soon, the heavenly soldiers and generals began to fall back.
summary_zh: 沉香挥舞神斧与天兵天将激战，凭借高强武艺和越战越勇的气势，使天兵天将逐渐败退。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 沉香瞅准机会，一跃而起，在空中扬起神斧，用尽所有力气劈向华山……
page_text_en: Shenxiang seized the opportunity, leaped into the air, raised his divine axe, and swung it with all his might toward Mount Hua...
summary_zh: 沉香在月夜中跃起，挥动神斧劈向华山，画面充满动感与力量。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
轰隆一声巨响，山峰被劈开了一道口子。
刹那间，宝莲灯发出耀眼的光芒。
page_text_en:
With a loud boom, a crack opened in the mountain peak.
Instantly, the Precious Lotus Lantern emitted a dazzling light.
summary_zh: 沉香挥动神斧劈开华山，山峰裂开一道口子，宝莲灯随之发出耀眼光芒。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 沉香的母亲从洞中缓缓地走了出来。受尽苦难的母亲终于重见天日了。
page_text_en: Shenxiang's mother slowly walked out of the cave. The mother, who had suffered greatly, was finally seeing the light of day again.
summary_zh: 沉香的母亲从被压的山洞中走出，重见天日，沉香激动地迎接母亲，画面充满团圆的喜悦。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh:
“娘亲！”“沉香！”母子俩紧紧相拥，抱头痛哭。
离开母亲时，沉香还是个婴儿，如今已经成长为这么勇敢坚定的少年，十多年的时光，真是漫长而又短暂！
page_text_en:
"Mother!" "Shenxiang!" The mother and son hugged tightly, crying bitterly.
When he left his mother, Shenxiang was still a baby; now he has grown into such a brave and determined youth. Thirteen years of time—so long, yet so brief!
summary_zh: 沉香劈开华山后，与母亲重逢，两人紧紧相拥，抱头痛哭，画面展现母子团圆的感人场景。

title_en: Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother
page_text_ocr_zh: 千百年来，高耸入云的华山似乎从来没有随着时间的推移而改变，而沉香劈山救母的传说，也伴着华山险峻的山峰一起，永久流传。
page_text_en: For thousands of years, the towering Mount Hua has remained unchanged, and the legend of Shenxiang splitting the mountain to save his mother has also been passed down, accompanying the perilous peaks of Hua Mountain, forever.
summary_zh: 画面描绘了沉香与母亲在华山之巅相望，背景是夕阳西下、仙鹤飞翔的壮丽景象，文字总结了沉香劈山救母的传说将永远流传。
